Name: Simple Armor Passive Picker 1.2.0
Description: Pick the passive and the armor rating (50 to 150, odd ones like 64, 79 and 129 included) of the armor you are wearing, from two small boxes on the player card. The look stays the same. F6 keeps them across game starts. Requires Bingus Shared Loader v15+, loaded last.
